---
title: "Numbers stored as text compare like words"
ref: FCT-04
categories: [Factors]
impact: silencieux
extrait: 'max(c("10", "9"))'
reponse: '"9"'
attendu: "`\"10\"`"

source: "The R Inferno"

::: {.piege}
```{r}
max(c("10", "9"))
sort(c("10", "9", "100"))
"10" < "9"
```
:::

## Why

On text, `max()`, `sort()` and `<` follow alphabetical order, character by character. `"10"` starts with `"1"`, which comes before `"9"`: so it is "smaller". The length of the string only matters in case of a tie.

Such text often comes from reading a file where a single non-numeric cell turned the whole column into characters.

## The fix

Convert to numbers before comparing or sorting, and check for `NA`s produced by the conversion.

::: {.piege}
```{r}
values <- as.numeric(c("10", "9", "100"))
max(values)
sort(values)
```
:::
